title: Assholes are Ruining Your Project. Donnie Berkholz (RedMonk).
summary: Donnie Berkholz of RedMonk gives a Monki Gras talk arguing that abusive, toxic contributors damage open source projects. He makes the case for removing them from communities.
why: Cited as the go-to evidence that rudeness drives contributors away and that toxic people must be removed from projects.

quote.text: Assholes will ruin your project[1], you need to get rid of them
